name: Find the Gems

angles.text: Alliance dwarves have pushed into Uldaman, and notes from their camp help pinpoint where ancient stones lie hidden among the troggs.

faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel is a gnome in financial trouble who needs the gems recovered to save his professional reputation.
The ruby rests behind a Shadowforge barricade, the topaz sits in an urn near an Alliance dwarf camp, and the trogg chieftain Grimlok carries the sapphire.
faq.q: Where are the gems hidden in Uldaman?

faq.answer: Grimlok is the leader of the troggs inside Uldaman, and he has claimed the sapphire for himself.
The Phial of Scrying allows you to contact Talvash del Kissel remotely through water, though each attempt consumes valuable magic that Talvash cannot afford to waste.
faq.q: What is the Phial of Scrying?

sections.body: A recovered journal points deeper into the ancient halls of Uldaman, where three precious stones were lost. A ruby sits stashed behind a Shadowforge barricade, while an urn near an Alliance expedition holds a topaz. To claim the sapphire, you must face Grimlok, the chieftain of the troggs who infests the ruins. Once the stones are yours, a splash of water and the Phial of Scrying will reach Talvash without leaving the tunnels.
sections.title: Stones in the Deep

summary: Talvash del Kissel needs three lost gems retrieved from the halls of Uldaman to rescue his battered reputation. With notes from a recovered journal, you must scour trogg dens and dark iron redoubts before contacting the anxious gnome through a magical scrying phial.
attribution: In-game quest text: Find the Gems
